# Template: neuron
A schematic neuron drawn left to right: branching dendrites, the cell body (soma) with its nucleus, a long axon with optional myelin sheath segments and nodes of Ranvier, axon terminals, an "action potential" direction arrow, and an optional magnified synapse inset (presynaptic bouton, vesicles, neurotransmitter crossing the cleft, postsynaptic membrane). Choose this scene for ANY request about neurons or nerve cells, axons and dendrites, myelin or saltatory conduction, nodes of Ranvier, action potentials traveling along a nerve, or synapses and neurotransmitters.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "myelinated": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Myelin sheath segments on the axon (default true)."
  },
  "dendrites": {
   "type": "integer",
   "description": "How many dendrite branches, 2-8 (default 5)."
  },
  "show_impulse": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Arrow showing the action potential's direction of travel (default true)."
  },
  "show_synapse": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Magnified synapse inset below the axon terminals (default false)."
  },
  "labels": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Part names (dendrites, soma, axon, myelin, node of Ranvier, terminals) (default true)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- dendrites: the dendrite branches (a group)
- soma: the cell body outline
- nucleus: the nucleus inside the soma
- axon: the axon line
- myelin: the myelin sheath segments (a group; myelinated only)
- terminals: the axon terminal branches with their boutons (a group)
- impulse: the action-potential direction arrow (when show_impulse)
- synapse: the magnified synapse inset (a group; when show_synapse)
- label_dendrites: part name (when labels; likewise label_soma, label_axon, label_myelin, label_node, label_terminals, label_impulse, label_synapse)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw a labeled neuron with myelin sheath and nodes of Ranvier." → params: {"title":"The neuron"}
Request: "Show a neuron with a magnified synapse." → params: {"show_synapse":true,"title":"Neuron and synapse"}

In YAML: `template: neuron` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
